content.json:
## Sanction & Forgive: operations
Built from the audit line each screening writes (docs/api.md, "What's logged"): its reference, outcome, versions and what each list answered. Nothing entered is in it, so nothing entered is here. Request refusals come from the platform's request metrics. The workspace keeps 30 days.

parameters.name: Callers
parameters.label: Callers (by reference)
parameters.jsonData: [{"value": "API", "label": "API", "selected": true}, {"value": "Website", "label": "Website (web-)", "selected": true}, {"value": "Manifest page", "label": "Manifest page (manifest-)", "selected": true}, {"value": "Smoke test", "label": "Smoke tests (smoke-)", "selected": false}, {"value": "Load test", "label": "Load tests (load-)", "selected": false}]

content.query:
let screenings = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__APP_NAME__"
| extend Entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Message = tostring(Entry.Message), Reference = coalesce(tostring(Entry.Reference), tostring(Entry.State.Reference))
| where Message startswith "Screening "
| extend Outcome = extract(@": (Match|Review|Incomplete|NoMatch); matcher ", 1, Message)
| extend Caller = case(Reference startswith "web-", "Website", Reference startswith "manifest-", "Manifest page", Reference startswith "smoke-", "Smoke test", Reference startswith "load-", "Load test", "API")
| where Caller in ({Callers});
screenings
| summarize Screenings = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain}), Outcome
| render timechart
content.title: Screenings by outcome

content.query:
let screenings = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__APP_NAME__"
| extend Entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Message = tostring(Entry.Message), Reference = coalesce(tostring(Entry.Reference), tostring(Entry.State.Reference))
| where Message startswith "Screening "
| extend Outcome = extract(@": (Match|Review|Incomplete|NoMatch); matcher ", 1, Message)
| extend Caller = case(Reference startswith "web-", "Website", Reference startswith "manifest-", "Manifest page", Reference startswith "smoke-", "Smoke test", Reference startswith "load-", "Load test", "API")
| where Caller in ({Callers});
screenings
| summarize Screenings = count(), Match = countif(Outcome == "Match"), Review = countif(Outcome == "Review"), Incomplete = countif(Outcome == "Incomplete"), NoMatch = countif(Outcome == "NoMatch") by Caller
| extend ["Match %"] = round(100.0 * Match / Screenings, 1), ["Review %"] = round(100.0 * Review / Screenings, 1), ["Incomplete %"] = round(100.0 * Incomplete / Screenings, 1)
| order by Screenings desc
content.title: Outcome mix by caller

content.query:
let screenings = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__APP_NAME__"
| extend Entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Message = tostring(Entry.Message), Reference = coalesce(tostring(Entry.Reference), tostring(Entry.State.Reference))
| where Message startswith "Screening "
| extend Outcome = extract(@": (Match|Review|Incomplete|NoMatch); matcher ", 1, Message)
| extend Caller = case(Reference startswith "web-", "Website", Reference startswith "manifest-", "Manifest page", Reference startswith "smoke-", "Smoke test", Reference startswith "load-", "Load test", "API")
| where Caller in ({Callers});
let named = (pattern: string, state: string) {
    screenings
    | extend Lists = set_union(extract_all(pattern, Message), dynamic([]))
    | mv-expand List = Lists to typeof(string)
    | where isnotempty(List)
    | extend State = state
};
union
    named(@"([a-z0-9-]+) NotChecked", "Not checked"),
    named(@"([a-z0-9-]+)@[0-9-]+ overdue", "Searched while overdue"),
    named(@"([a-z0-9-]+)@[0-9-]+ off", "Switched off")
| summarize Screenings = count(), First = min(TimeGenerated), Last = max(TimeGenerated) by List, State
| order by Last desc
content.title: Lists not checked, overdue or switched off, as screenings found them
content.noDataMessage: No audit line in the range names a list not checked, overdue or switched off (nor any line at all if none was ingested: see Screenings by outcome).

content.query:
let screenings = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__APP_NAME__"
| extend Entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Message = tostring(Entry.Message), Reference = coalesce(tostring(Entry.Reference), tostring(Entry.State.Reference))
| where Message startswith "Screening "
| extend Outcome = extract(@": (Match|Review|Incomplete|NoMatch); matcher ", 1, Message)
| extend Caller = case(Reference startswith "web-", "Website", Reference startswith "manifest-", "Manifest page", Reference startswith "smoke-", "Smoke test", Reference startswith "load-", "Load test", "API")
| where Caller in ({Callers});
screenings
| extend Hits = extract_all(@"(?:: |; )([a-z0-9-]+) (Match|Review)( allowed)? [0-9]+%", Message)
| mv-expand Hit = Hits
| where isnotempty(Hit)
| extend List = tostring(Hit[0]), Cell = strcat(tostring(Hit[1]), tostring(Hit[2]))
| summarize Cells = count() by List, Cell
| evaluate pivot(Cell, sum(Cells))
| order by List asc
content.title: Possible matches by list (cells at Match or Review; "allowed": a Review the allow-list keeps from raising the outcome, still there to review)
content.noDataMessage: No audit line in the range names a possible match.

content.query:
let screenings = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__APP_NAME__"
| extend Entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Message = tostring(Entry.Message), Reference = coalesce(tostring(Entry.Reference), tostring(Entry.State.Reference))
| where Message startswith "Screening "
| extend Outcome = extract(@": (Match|Review|Incomplete|NoMatch); matcher ", 1, Message)
| extend Caller = case(Reference startswith "web-", "Website", Reference startswith "manifest-", "Manifest page", Reference startswith "smoke-", "Smoke test", Reference startswith "load-", "Load test", "API")
| where Caller in ({Callers});
screenings
| extend Destinations = extract_all(@"\(destination (restricted|possiblyRestricted) ([A-Za-z0-9-]+)\)", Message)
| mv-expand Destination = Destinations
| where isnotempty(Destination)
| summarize Notices = count() by State = tostring(Destination[0]), Row = tostring(Destination[1])
| order by Notices desc
content.title: Destination notices, by the table's row
content.noDataMessage: No audit line in the range names a destination notice.

content.query:
let screenings = ContainerAppConsoleLogs_CL
| where ContainerAppName_s == "__APP_NAME__"
| extend Entry = parse_json(Log_s)
| extend Message = tostring(Entry.Message), Reference = coalesce(tostring(Entry.Reference), tostring(Entry.State.Reference))
| where Message startswith "Screening "
| extend Outcome = extract(@": (Match|Review|Incomplete|NoMatch); matcher ", 1, Message)
| extend Caller = case(Reference startswith "web-", "Website", Reference startswith "manifest-", "Manifest page", Reference startswith "smoke-", "Smoke test", Reference startswith "load-", "Load test", "API")
| where Caller in ({Callers});
screenings
| extend Matcher = extract(@"; matcher ([0-9a-f]+);", 1, Message), Lists = strcat_array(array_sort_asc(split(extract(@"; lists ([^;]*);", 1, Message), ", ")), ", ")
| summarize Screenings = count(), From = min(TimeGenerated), To = max(TimeGenerated) by Matcher, Lists
| order by To desc
content.title: Versions screened against (matcher, and each list's version)
